'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Jake Nelson LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
